collections:tree.fork: Verb (menu action): create a personal copy of the collection. Turkish: "Fork'la".
forks:fork.submit: Verb (dialog submit button) that creates the fork.
forks:status.open: Adjective: state of a merge request that is not merged or closed yet.
forks:panel.filters.Open: Adjective (filter): show only open merge requests.
forks:mr.merge: Verb (button): apply the merge request to the source collection. See docs/terimler.md, "Merge isteği".
forks:mr.changes: Noun (tab title): the list of differences in the merge request.
gitsync:pull.take: Git pull: bring commits from the remote branch into Apivator.
collections:tree.run: Verb: open the collection runner for this collection or folder.
runner:dialog.tabRun: Noun (tab title): run settings, as opposed to the results tab.
requests:editor.send: Verb (primary button): send the HTTP request.
requests:workspace.hintSend: Lowercase verb shown next to a keyboard shortcut (e.g. "Ctrl+Enter send").
requests:workspace.hintSave: Lowercase verb shown next to a keyboard shortcut (e.g. "Ctrl+S save").
requests:auth.flow: OAuth 2.0 grant type (Authorization Code, Client Credentials…). The flow names themselves are not translated.
requests:auth.scope: OAuth 2.0 scope. Turkish keeps the English word in parentheses.
docs:auth.Inherit: Auth type label: the request uses the auth of its folder or collection.
docs:view.secret: Badge on a secret variable; its value is hidden on the published page.
scripts:completions.scopeLocal: Variable scope in script autocompletion (pm.variables, local to this run).
account:apiKeys.revoke: Verb: permanently disable the API key. Not "cancel".
activity:panel.restore: Verb: restore a deleted request or collection from the activity feed.
audit:dataLabels.owner: Column label in the audit log: owner of the changed item.
collab:fields.body: Request body field name in a change summary. Keep the product term "Body" (docs/terimler.md).
docs:view.bodyTitle: Section title on the documentation page for the request body.
console:clear: Verb: clear the console log entries.
history:clearConfirm: Verb (confirm button): delete the request history.
monitors:detail.status: Noun: the monitor's last result (passing, failing, paused).
